lines.text: Imagine a team of marketers running your ads. They set up campaigns, make the creatives, and check the results every day.
Managed Campaigns is that team, as one AI agent.
Connect your ad accounts, and pick where your ads run: Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and four more.
Set a daily budget, and a goal, like more sales.
The agent studies your account's history, builds the campaign, and makes the ads.
It launches on its own, then checks the results every day. It pauses what loses money, and moves budget to what sells.
You pay the ad platforms for the spend. Ryze takes a five percent fee only on the campaigns the agent manages for you, nothing else. And the more you spend, the lower the rate.
[warm] That's it. Start your first managed campaign today.
